title: JSON from/to native functions don't work with Infinity or NaN values
body:
### Tested versions

4.5-stable

### System information

macOS 15.7

### Issue description

Note: This issue is not the same as #89777.

Godot has its own functions on the JSON class called `from_native` and `to_native`. These functions produce values which are friendlier for Godot to parse back. For example, the float `1.0` gets turned into `f:1.0`, which Godot then knows to deserialize as a float when using `to_native`. Similarly, the int `5` gets turned into `i:5`, which Godot then knows to deserialize as an int when using `to_native`. There are also prefixes for String `s:`, StringName `sn:`, and NodePath `np:`, and other types have other serializations.

However, these functions don't work for Infinity or NaN values. They get read back as `0.0` by `JSON.to_native`. See the below code.

Internally, `JSON.to_native` uses `String::to_float()`. One option would be to change `String::to_float()` to handle `"inf"` and `"nan"`. Or, we could change the code in `JSON::_to_native` to check for these values.

The `JSON.from_native` function already outputs `"f:inf"` and `"f:nan"`, so those could be kept as-is to keep the changes minimal. Or, these could be changed if we desire a different value. Either way, these JSON functions are an internal format, they are only useful for transferring Godot data to other Godot instances via JSON, so it's just a matter of what we want to do for Godot's own internal uses, without the concern of compatibility breakage.

### Steps to reproduce

Run this GDScript code to reproduce:

```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
	print(JSON.from_native(5)) # Prints i:5
	print(JSON.to_native(JSON.from_native(5))) # Prints 5
	print(JSON.from_native(1.0)) # Prints f:1.0
	print(JSON.to_native(JSON.from_native(1.0))) # Prints 1.0
	print(JSON.from_native(INF)) # Prints f:inf
	print(JSON.to_native(JSON.from_native(INF))) # Prints 0.0
	print(JSON.from_native(-INF)) # Prints f:-inf
	print(JSON.to_native(JSON.from_native(-INF))) # Prints 0.0
	print(JSON.from_native(NAN)) # Prints f:nan
	print(JSON.to_native(JSON.from_native(NAN))) # Prints 0.0
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Copy the above lines of code to replace the `_ready` function in a new script in a new project.
